scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix Frontend --include=dev && npm ci --prefix Backend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix Frontend && npm run db:generate --prefix Backend
scripts.start: npm run db:migrate:deploy --prefix Backend && npm run start --prefix Backend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix Backend && npm install --prefix Frontend && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate --prefix Backend
